title: LINQ: group orders by customer

title: Quiz: the event loop
instructions: Pick the order in which the four log lines print.

answer.explanation: Synchronous logs run first (A, D). Microtasks (the resolved promise) drain before the next macrotask, so C precedes the setTimeout callback B.
